title: Annual report.
bodyText: The board shall report on its activities to the governor and the legislature at the end of each fiscal year, and may include recommendations consistent with the purposes of this chapter.
bodyHtml: [§348F-4]  Annual report.  The board shall report on its activities to the governor and the legislature at the end of each fiscal year, and may include recommendations consistent with the purposes of this chapter. [L 1999, c 282, pt of §2]
